title: P2-14b shard-coalesce: Add coalesce_window_us: u64 to ShardConfig (default 100µs) and coalescing layer in Shard::tick
description: Feature P2-14b (split from black-hat-revised vb-8fbja). Black-hat review round 1 split the original P2-14 into 3 sub-beads; this is the second. This bead (P2-14b) handles sub-phase (14b) only: add coalesce_window_us to ShardConfig and a coalescing layer in Shard::tick. Depends on P2-14a (the storage batch is needed for the coalesced commands to commit in one transaction). Real source: crates/vb_runtime/src/shard/config.rs (ShardConfig — does not currently have coalesce_window_us; this bead adds it; the field is part of ShardConfig v2 from P0-COORD), crates/vb_runtime/src/shard/tick.rs (Shard::tick — does not currently coalesce commands; this bead adds a coalescing layer). The new logic: Shard::tick collects commands arriving within a 100µs window, batches them into a single slice, and calls append_sequenced_batch (from P2-14a) once. Master §61: coalesce window is a positive u64; 0 is treated as 'no batching' (not a default). Kani harness: prove Shard::tick within the coalesce window produces exactly 1 batch commit. proptest: 100 random (command_burst, window_us) pairs assert batching behavior.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL expose coalesce_window_us: u64 in ShardConfig (default 100µs)
THE SYSTEM SHALL coalesce Shard::tick commands arriving within the window into a single batch commit

event_driven.trigger: WHEN Shard::tick processes 100 commands within a 100µs window
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL emit 1 batch commit (via P2-14a's append_sequenced_batch) and the next 100 commands after the window expires

unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT treat coalesce_window_us=0 as the default; the default is 100us and 0 is a valid explicit opt-out
unwanted.because: Operators must explicitly opt in to the no-batching path for benchmarking

unwanted.condition: IF a command arrives exactly at the window boundary
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT lose or double-count a command at the window boundary; the boundary semantics are inclusive-of-start, exclusive-of-end
unwanted.because: Master §61: window boundary semantics must be deterministic for replay

preconditions: P2-14a (storage-batch) has landed and append_sequenced_batch is the new batch commit API
P0-COORD has defined ShardConfig v2 (this bead adds coalesce_window_us to it)
postconditions: Shard::tick coalesces commands within the window and calls append_sequenced_batch once per window
Setting coalesce_window_us = 0 disables coalescing (each command is committed individually)
invariants: 100 commands within the window produce 1 batch commit, not 100 (master §61 throughput invariant)
Window boundary is inclusive-of-start, exclusive-of-end (deterministic for replay)

happy: shard_tick_coalesces_within_window: 100 commands in 100µs; assert 1 batch commit
error: shard_tick_with_window_zero_does_not_batch: coalesce_window_us = 0; assert 100 commits for 100 commands (no batching)
negative_test_compile_failure_path_returns_typed_error: a malformed input is rejected with the correct typed error code (per schema contract)
edge: shard_tick_at_window_boundary_is_deterministic: 1 command at t=0, 1 command at t=100µs (boundary); assert the boundary command is in the next batch
proptest_shard_tick_batching: 100 random (command_burst, window_us) pairs; assert the batch count matches expectations
kani_shard_tick_window_semantics: bounded model check with 4 command patterns and 4 window sizes

files: crates/vb_runtime/src/shard/config.rs (ShardConfig — the field we add; the v2 schema is from P0-COORD)
crates/vb_runtime/src/shard/tick.rs (Shard::tick — the coalescing layer we add)
crates/vb_runtime/src/shard/command.rs (ShardCommand — the command type that gets coalesced)
patterns: Pattern: existing Shard::tick processes commands one at a time; we add a coalescing buffer in front of it
questions: Should the coalesce window be measured in monotonic clock time (SystemTime::now()) or tick count? Recommend: monotonic clock time (SystemTime) for replay determinism; monotonic clock is required by master §68.4

data_integrity_failures.failure: Coalescing loses a command at the window boundary; the command is silently dropped, and the run state diverges
data_integrity_failures.prevention: Boundary semantics are inclusive-of-start, exclusive-of-end, and tested in proptest_shard_tick_batching

security_failures.failure: Attacker sets coalesce_window_us to u64::MAX, causing unbounded memory growth in the coalescing buffer
security_failures.prevention: ShardConfig validates coalesce_window_us in [0, 1_000_000] (max 1 second); values outside return ConfigOutOfBounds
